description: A blog with one owned table, a declarative admin screen and a public JSON feed of published posts. The screen is drawn from the fields declared here: a title, a slug derived from it, a prose box, a draft/published switch and a date. It declares no hooks, and its only public URL is GET /_plugin/blog/posts.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Web address
fields.help: Filled from the title. Short, lower-case, hyphenated — it is the post's URL.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Post
fields.help: The text of the post, as Markdown.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Visibility
fields.help: Only a published post appears in the public feed.

fields.name: published_at
fields.label: Publish date
fields.help: Leave empty until you know the date; the feed sorts by it, newest first.
